capability_maturity_levels.candidate: Known possible capability or runtime; not active until owner, config surface, conformance, evidence, failure mode, and runbook exist.
capability_maturity_levels.active-local-proof: Active local proof capability or runtime; useful for developer validation without production admission.
capability_maturity_levels.active-production-runtime: Reviewed production runtime capability with owner, delivery path, evidence, failure mode, and runbook.
capability_maturity_levels.deprecated: Retired or being removed; kept only while workloads migrate away.

runtime_targets.implementation: Docker Compose + local Postgres/PgBouncer + Redis-backed Dapr + OSS observability

Richer local workload contract proof for network, storage, compute, probes, jobs, service identity, and runtime policy without cloud Kubernetes machinery.

runtime_targets.implementation: AWS ECS/Fargate + ALB/WAF + RDS + SNS/SQS + S3 + EventBridge Scheduler
runtime_targets.purpose: Current reviewed production realization of the workload contract.

runtime_capabilities.contract_surface: workload contract, runtime conformance, local config names

runtime_capabilities.contract_surface: local edge authentication default and explicit dev-token opt-in
runtime_capabilities.implementation: Local workloads run without authentication by default; workloads that declare static bearer auth can enforce a configured dev token

runtime_capabilities.contract_surface: local workload host identity evidence
runtime_capabilities.implementation: Docker Compose service names, container names, and network aliases identify local workload hosts

runtime_capabilities.contract_surface: declared config secret names and local env or mounted file injection
runtime_capabilities.implementation: Local runs use environment variables and local files only; committed secret values are rejected by repository gates

runtime_capabilities.contract_surface: repository policy checks for workload metadata, runtime conformance, and workflows
runtime_capabilities.implementation: OPA/Conftest validates platform metadata locally through lint-policy

runtime_capabilities.contract_surface: declared ports, Compose service names, and local runtime conformance endpoints
runtime_capabilities.implementation: Docker Compose networks provide local internal connectivity; host ports are explicit in compose.yaml

runtime_capabilities.contract_surface: local validation commands and runtime conformance evidence
runtime_capabilities.implementation: Make targets and pytest prove local workload behavior before cloud-changing delivery

runtime_capabilities.contract_surface: Prometheus metrics, structured logs, optional OTLP traces, and workload identity labels

runtime_capabilities.contract_surface: app-local business authorization by default plus repository policy checks
runtime_capabilities.implementation: Workloads keep business checks local when needed; OPA/Conftest validates repository contracts

runtime_capabilities.contract_surface: workload contract, runtime conformance, local config names, Kubernetes probes, jobs, services, and storage claims
runtime_capabilities.implementation: kind cluster with kubectl-applied static manifests for selected workload boundary proof

runtime_capabilities.contract_surface: local Kubernetes edge authentication default and explicit dev-token opt-in
runtime_capabilities.implementation: The API workload can enforce the same declared static bearer token when configured through a Kubernetes Secret

runtime_capabilities.contract_surface: declared config secret names and Kubernetes Secret injection

runtime_capabilities.contract_surface: repository policy checks for workload metadata, runtime defaults, catalog, and Kubernetes manifests
runtime_capabilities.implementation: OPA/Conftest and pytest contract checks validate the local Kubernetes runtime contract surface

runtime_capabilities.contract_surface: runtime identity and delivery identity evidence

candidate_runtime_capabilities.contract_surface: standard workload metrics, logs, traces, run IDs, image tags, timestamps, status, and artifact paths
